related_questions.question: Can I withdraw money from my Voya retirement account?

text_blocks.snippet: Generally, you can withdraw money from a Voya retirement account, but there are rules and potential penalties depending on your age and the type of account. You can typically withdraw funds after age 59 1/2 without penalty. Before that age, you may face taxes and penalties, though exceptions exist for hardship withdrawals or unforeseeable emergencies.

list.title: Age 59 1/2 or older:
list.snippet: You can generally withdraw money from your Voya retirement account for any reason, and withdrawals can be taken as often as twice a year, according to Voya.

list.title: Before age 59 1/2:
list.snippet: You may face a 10% penalty on the withdrawn amount, in addition to regular income taxes on the withdrawal, according to Voya.

list.title: Exceptions:
list.snippet: You may be able to withdraw money before age 59 1/2 in cases of hardship or unforeseeable emergencies, but these situations often require proof and may still be subject to taxes and penalties, says Voya.

list.title: Reasons:
list.snippet: Hardship withdrawals are generally allowed for situations like unexpected medical expenses, home purchase or repair costs, tuition, or funeral expenses.

list.title: Restrictions:
list.snippet: These withdrawals are usually limited to the amount needed to cover the specific hardship, and they are still subject to taxes and potential penalties.

list.title: Reasons:
list.snippet: These are similar to hardship withdrawals but may be granted for more severe situations like a sudden illness or accident, property loss, or other circumstances beyond your control, according to Voya.

list.title: Restrictions:
list.snippet: The amount withdrawn is limited to what's needed to address the emergency and may still be subject to taxes and penalties.

list.title: 1. Check your plan details:
list.snippet: Review the specific rules and restrictions for your Voya retirement plan, as they can vary.

list.title: 2. Determine your eligibility:
list.snippet: Confirm whether you meet the age or hardship criteria for a withdrawal.

list.title: 3. Contact Voya:
list.snippet: Reach out to Voya customer service for guidance on the withdrawal process, including required forms and documentation.

list.title: 4. Consider professional advice:
list.snippet: Consult with a financial advisor or tax professional before making any withdrawals, especially if you're considering a hardship or early withdrawal.

text_blocks.snippet: Note: It's crucial to understand the potential tax implications and penalties associated with withdrawing money from your retirement account before you actually do so.

text_blocks.snippet: Voya Financial uses State Street Bank and Trust Company for its core retirement plan funds and State Street Global Markets, LLC for Self-Managed Accounts. Additionally, for its insured bank deposit accounts, Voya Financial Advisors partners with various banks including Barclays Bank Delaware, United Community Bank, Bremer Bank, and Citibank. BNY Mellon also plays a role in Voya's financial services, with Pershing LLC, a BNY Mellon company, providing brokerage and custody services, and BNY Mellon, N.A. providing credit services.
